description: Design system foundation + all shared primitives. Replace the maroon/saffron/ivory @theme tokens with the dark navy/gold design system in globals.css. Update constants.ts brand identity to R. Anand. Update layout.tsx metadata. Restyle all 5 UI components (Button, Card, SectionHeading, Breadcrumb, Logo) and all 4 layout components (Navbar, Footer, WhatsAppButton, WelcomePopup). This FEAT has no dependency on any other FEAT and must land first because every page imports these primitives.

Edit src/app/globals.css @theme block: remove --color-maroon, --color-maroon-light, --color-maroon-dark, --color-saffron, --color-saffron-light, --color-saffron-dark, --color-ivory, --color-ivory-dark, --color-charcoal, --color-charcoal-light. Add: --color-primary:#101C35, --color-background:#080F20, --color-secondary:#182744, --color-gold:#B89552, --color-gold-light:#E5CC91, --color-cream:#F3EBDD, --color-text:#F8F5ED, --color-muted:#AAB3C4. Keep --font-serif and --font-sans unchanged.

2. Update @layer base in globals.css: body gets `background-color: var(--color-background); color: var(--color-text)`. h1-h6 get `color: var(--color-gold)`. ::selection gets `background-color: var(--color-gold); color: var(--color-background)`. Scrollbar track: var(--color-background), thumb: var(--color-gold). :focus-visible ring: var(--color-gold).

3. Update @layer components in globals.css: .vedic-pattern SVG fill hex from %237B1E3A to %23B89552. .text-gradient becomes gold gradient. .form-input gets `bg-secondary border-secondary/40 text-text`. Add .glass-panel class: `background: rgba(16,28,53,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(184,149,82,0.2)`. Add .gold-border class: `border: 1px solid rgba(184,149,82,0.3)`. Add .celestial-glow class: `background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(184,149,82,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%)`. Add @keyframes pulse-glow for gold shimmer.

4. Edit src/lib/constants.ts: Update BRAND to { name: 'R. Anand Purohit & Vedic Astrologer', tagline: 'Authentic Vedic Wisdom, Celestial Guidance', description: 'Expert Vedic Astrology, KP Astrology, Vaastu, Numerology and sacred Pooja & Homa services.', whatsappNumber: '+918123235638', email: 'anandradhakrishna@gmail.com', phone: '+91 81232 35638' }. 6. Edit src/components/ui/button.tsx: update cva base to use 'focus-visible:ring-gold focus-visible:ring-offset-background'. Replace variants: primary → dark navy with gold border + glow shadow; gold (new, replaces saffron) → bg-gold text-background gold glow; secondary → transparent gold border; ghost → transparent gold hover; link → gold text underline. findings: 1. The 'saffron' Button variant was renamed to 'gold'. All page files that used variant='saffron' (page.tsx, contact/page.tsx, astrology/page.tsx, my-journey/page.tsx, services/page.tsx, blogs/page.tsx, blogs/[slug]/page.tsx, poojas/[slug]/page.tsx, talk-to-us/page.tsx) were updated to variant='gold' — later FEATs must NOT use variant='saffron'. 2. BRAND.phoneSecondary and BRAND.address were removed from constants.ts. The contact/page.tsx had two references that were fixed: the info cards array (address entry replaced with a Consult link) and the phoneSecondary anchor link (removed, keeping only the primary phone link). Later FEATs must not reference BRAND.phoneSecondary or BRAND.address. 3. Tailwind v4 token names changed: old tokens (maroon, saffron, ivory, charcoal, charcoal-light) are gone; new tokens are primary, background, secondary, gold, gold-light, cream, text, muted. Any page still using old Tailwind class names (bg-maroon, text-saffron, etc.) will appear visually wrong but will NOT cause TypeScript build errors since Tailwind v4 does not type-check utility classes. Remaining old class names in pages will be addressed in subsequent FEATs.
